answer: Sponsors are capped at 6 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 75 POA until the newcomer survives 13 clean epochs, and a farm of 260 fakes must find 260 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. The orchard is the check that cannot be faked, the terrace is the price the attacker pays, and the pulse is the record that outlives the epoch.
